ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible field, with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels limited to sparse distal spotting.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes; localized clusters of high-contrast white micro-spots (specks) are mapped primarily to the distal tips and the trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 90 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, moderate-frequency serrations visible along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits more pronounced jagged peaks at the distal end, while the left lobe shows a significant localized indentation approximately one-third inward from the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch extending to the distal tips; trailing edge maintains a generally linear to slightly concave progression between peaks.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of white, circular point-clusters concentrated at the terminal tips of both lobes and scattered across the visible distal half of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant notch or semi-circular truncation on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe; white scarring/colonization on the far right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-intensity pixel occlusion due to water spray obscuring the lower central fluke and mid-regions of the lobes.
